player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Agodifo {player_id} ({piece}). Oponeneti ne ({opp}).
Fa kwan pa sɛ '[a2 a3]' (firi → kɔ).
- Kwan pa mu yɛ kwan foforo a wofa kɔ vertex a ɛda hɔ a ɛwɔ.
- Akyere yɛ a wokɔ akyiri a wofa kɔ node a ɛwɔ a ɛnyɛ hɔ.
Kwan biara a wofa akyere no ma wo {score_per_capture} pɔinti.
Agodifo no bɛba awiee wɔ {max_moves} kwan akyi anaa sɛ agodifo biara nni kwan a ɔfɛ fa.

invalid_move.bad_format: Nhyehyɛe bɔne. Fa '[a2 a3]' di dwuma.
invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Ɛhɔ a wɔrekɔ no nyɛ baabi hunu.
